summary:
Findings:

1. Medium: The runtime layout test will fail. `Engine` gained an 8-byte function field at [engine.go:29](/tmp/wago-gc-native-segment-cache/src/core/runtime/engine.go:29). The expected layout does not include it at [limits_test.go:10](/tmp/wago-gc-native-segment-cache/src/core/runtime/limits_test.go:10). On amd64, the sizes differ by 8 bytes.

2. Low: `store=true` does not test a store-owned GC domain. It creates a plain store at [gc_native_read_cache_amd64_test.go:118](/tmp/wago-gc-native-segment-cache/src/wago/gc_native_read_cache_amd64_test.go:118). With no GC topology, registration creates a private domain at [reference_store.go:1897](/tmp/wago-gc-native-segment-cache/src/wago/reference_store.go:1897). It does not set `executionFlagStoreOwnedGCCollector` at [reference_store.go:1912](/tmp/wago-gc-native-segment-cache/src/wago/reference_store.go:1912). Thus, the new flags=`0x10`, non-independent path has no direct test.

I found no concrete production safety defect in the new admission, boundary clearing, cache key, trap behavior, root handling, or ABI guard.

I did not run tests, as requested.
